Ambiguous attribution is withheld.","Headlines cover all load cases. In a model with nonlinear supports a mechanics combination is withheld unless one term is a solved load case with factor exactly 1, at least one other term exists, and every other term is a combination whose fixed-load count κ is defined and exactly 0; it is then formed from rows, with its operands' standing, as a solved state plus derived differences or bounds, not an equilibrium state. With a consuming constant effort a mechanics combination is withheld when its κ is undefined or differs from 1 by more than 64ε, and an absolute sum or SRSS unless every operand's κ is exactly 0. Mechanics combinations, absolute sums and SRSS are also withheld for mixed moduli over the load cases they reach, and every combination is withheld with a withheld operand combination. Absolute sums and SRSS are unsigned. Subtraction is a labelled difference.
